description: Rodinia PathFinder: dynamic-programming minimum-cost path down a 2D cost grid. Faithful port of the original dynproc_kernel using pyramidal shared-memory temporal blocking (pyramid_height rows advanced per launch with a ghost-zone border). One recorded pass is a full top-to-bottom traversal of all rows; all pyramidal launches accumulate into one dynproc_kernel record.

scaling_param.name: cols
scaling_param.description: Number of grid columns (width). The original standard run uses 100000.

non_scaling_params.name: rows
non_scaling_params.description: Number of grid rows (height / number of DP time steps). Controls launches/pass = ceil((rows-1)/pyramid_height).

non_scaling_params.name: pyramid_height
non_scaling_params.description: Rows advanced per kernel launch (temporal blocking factor). Must satisfy pyramid_height < BLOCK_SIZE/2 = 128.

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block (fixed compile-time BLOCK_SIZE in the original kernel).
